rows.input: public route, hand-built PackedRegisteredMargins with a dict-subclass mapping that returns the pinned values to the first 4 item reads and 0.0 after (LF3, GPU)
CPU recording fakes: stateful mapping pinned to 2 reads, at lookup (D64 lookup / D128 attention, epsilon 0.01)
CPU recording fakes: stateful mapping pinned to 4 reads, at attention (D64 lookup / D128 attention, epsilon 0.01)
S4 host-level fake (real guard and EB2b prologue text, g++ -O0 -fwrapv, stub NDArray): B*H at bound, one past, 65536^2; extents 2^31 on k axis 2 and q axis 0; q B = 0
rows.F2: the same inputs on the real Build F2 entries are the LF3 rows above (eb2b_BH_*, extent_*, zero_*)

note: Every R3' row refuses before any launch on Build F3 (launches 0). Build F2 also refused every large-extent input before any launch, but with RuntimeError or with another entry's ValueError (the capacity check, or packed_rotate's B*H after a wrapped EB2b product). Zero extents keep the RuntimeError on both builds. R1': Build F2 used the 0.0 read at use (e_q 0.0); Build F3 uses the pinned value.
